_about: The MENU for the Animated Shorts task. Each entry under `series` is one animation style (a series). Add a new style by adding an entry here plus its renderer folder and its rules file; the task needs no other change. status: active | trial | paused.

funnel.name: Funnel: where the money goes
funnel.title_zone: 2 centred lines, Lora Bold 86 px (auto-shrinks only if a line is too long), baselines y=395 and y=490 (SAFE layout: inside the 4:5 feed crop and below every app's top bar); counter (and logo, if any) on the row below at y=525; all content inside x 60-1020

household.name: Where the average household's money goes

news.name: Bonus: a money story in today's news

howbig.name: How big is it really? (1 square = 1 hour)
howbig.title_zone: same SAFE title zone as funnel: 2 centred lines, Lora Bold 86 px (auto-shrinks), baselines y=395 and y=490; simple key (one square = per-hour amount) at y=525; progress bar at y=1482 with the hour/money count under it (no black pill, user 12 Nov 2026); key above the source line; all content inside x 60-1020

outputs.thumbnail_offset_ms: thumb_ms in {slug}-build.json (the finished grid with the total hidden, near the end); no cold open in this series

public_cost.name: What a public cost or problem costs every hour

public_budget.name: What a public service costs every hour

news.name: Bonus: a money total in today's news

thennow.name: Then vs now (the line rides through time)
thennow.title_zone: same SAFE title zone as funnel/howbig: 2 centred lines, Lora Bold 86 px (auto-shrinks), baselines y=395 and y=490; year counter at y=525; all content inside x 60-1020

outputs.thumbnail_offset_ms: thumb_ms in {slug}-build.json (33 = the first frame; straight-in opening, no rewind: user rule 11 Nov 2026)

housing.name: Homes or rent then vs now

cost_of_living.name: An everyday price then vs now

pay_jobs.name: Pay, pensions or jobs then vs now

money_markets.name: Rates, inflation, currencies, markets or debt then vs now

news.name: Bonus: the long-term series behind today's headline

h2h.name: Head to head (two rivals, rounds and a scoreboard)
h2h.title_zone: same SAFE title zone as the other series: 2 centred lines, Lora Bold 86 px (auto-shrinks), baselines y=395 and y=490; scoreboard at y=525; all content inside x 60-1020

outputs.thumbnail_offset_ms: thumb_ms in {slug}-build.json (the table with the decider hidden); no cold open

countries.name: Country vs country economy
countries.repeat_key: pair (90 days unless all data newer)

places.name: City or region vs city or region

news.name: Bonus: the matchup behind today's headline
